title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2012 英语一 Section I 完形填空 · 本篇问题 4 题 + 历史弱项 4 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本篇复盘结果只有在你点击“提交结果到 GitHub”并在 GitHub 再点 Submit new issue 后，才会进入后续间隔复习。

questions.target: 标题具体性 / 反常现象的解释
questions.q: 文章解释两家书店线上订单增长后为何反而缩短店面营业：员工花更多时间拣书、包装和处理退件，留给接待店内顾客的时间减少。哪个标题最贴切？
o: Customer Ratings and Their Disputed Value
The Hidden Work Behind Shorter Opening Hours
The Search for Cheaper Storage Space
How Longer Hours Raised Book Sales

exp.trans: 线上订单增长带来拣书、包装和退件处理，占用店内服务时间，书店因此缩短营业。The Hidden Work Behind Shorter Opening Hours是“营业时间缩短背后不显眼的工作”。
exp.structure: 全文先给看似反常的现象，再解释员工时间如何转移。标题中的behind表示隐藏的原因；shorter opening hours保留要解释的现象。
exp.other: opening hours 营业时间；storage space 仓储空间；rating 评分；pick and pack 拣货和包装。
exp.meaning: 标题应抓解释关系，而非选与行业同主题的名词，也不凭“线上需求增长”推成营业一定延长。
exp.rest: Customer Ratings换成评分价值争论；Cheaper Storage把工作量转移变成仓储成本；Longer Hours反转实际营业变化，又把销量增长归因于延长营业，文中没有这种关系。

questions.skill: 转折逻辑不是正负翻转
questions.q: The manual warns that the batteries may fail below zero. Yet the field team left them outside overnight during a freeze. What does yet mainly signal?
o: 前句是负面，因此后句必须表达一个正面结果。
后句给出一个与前文警告所形成的合理预期相违的现实行为。
后句解释了为什么低温不会影响电池。
yet表示两件事按时间先后自然发生，没有对比。

exp.trans: 手册警告电池在零度以下可能失效。然而，野外团队却在严寒中把它们整夜放在室外。yet强调现实行为违背了前文警告所带来的正常预期。
exp.structure: 第一句The manual + warns + that从句。第二句the field team + left + them + outside；during a freeze交代环境。yet连接两个完整命题。
exp.other: manual 手册；battery 电池；below zero 零度以下；freeze 严寒/冰冻天气。
exp.meaning: yet/however/nevertheless的核心是命题层面的逆预期，不是“前负后正”或“前正后负”的机械符号。这里前文让人预期团队会避免低温，现实却相反。
exp.rest: A把转折简化成情感极性；C与第一句警告相冲突且没有证据；D忽略了yet的篇章功能。

questions.target: 社会信息 / 推断边界
questions.q: A shop’s guide calls replacing a worn battery “settling for yesterday’s technology.” It says nothing about whether a repaired phone would meet its owner’s needs. Which inference is best supported?
o: The guide judges repairs from owners’ reported dissatisfaction.
The guide compares replacements by how long they last.
The guide frames repair negatively without establishing that it fails to meet users’ needs.
The guide identifies a technical obstacle that prevents battery replacement.

exp.trans: 一家商店的指南把更换磨损的电池称为“将就使用过时技术”。它没有讨论修好的手机能否满足机主的需要。最有依据的推断是：它对维修附加了负面评价，却没有证明维修无法满足需要。
exp.structure: 主句A shop’s guide + calls + replacing a worn battery + 引语，call把维修描述成某种选择。It指guide；whether从句是about的补足内容，a repaired phone是该从句主语，would meet是谓语。
exp.other: worn 磨损的；settle for 将就接受；battery 电池；meet someone’s needs 满足某人的需要。
exp.meaning: 区分价值标签与功能证据。“过时”是指南附加的评价标签，不能直接升级为对实际需要是否得到满足的证据，也不必出现人身侮辱才有否定性信息。
exp.rest: reported dissatisfaction补出未报告的用户调查；how long they last偷换成使用寿命比较；technical obstacle把负面描述变成无法换电池的技术原因，三者都没有文本依据。

questions.q: After approving two applications, the panel rejected the rest as unjust to smaller firms. In this sentence, the rest and unjust mean:
o: 休息 / 仅仅的
其余申请 / 不公正的
其余评委 / 刚刚发生的
暂停审批 / 合法的

exp.trans: 批准两份申请后，评审组以“对小企业不公平”为由拒绝了其余申请。the rest指剩下的申请；unjust表示不公正的。
exp.structure: the panel是主语，rejected是谓语，the rest是宾语；as unjust to smaller firms说明把其余申请视为何种性质。After approving...是时间背景。
exp.other: application 申请；panel 评审组；approve 批准；firm 企业。
exp.meaning: rest单独可表示休息，但the rest (of...)常表示“其余的”；just既可作副词“仅仅/刚刚”，也可作形容词“公正的”，unjust由后者加un-构成“不公正的”。
exp.rest: A把两个熟词都套成最常见义；C误把the rest的先行集合换成评委，且unjust不是“刚刚”；D既不符合句法也不符合词义。

questions.skill: 词族辨析 + 语义一致性
questions.q: A report says that party politics can influence environmental policy, but it does not claim that every politician supports the same measure. Which reading is accurate?
o: 政党政策会影响环境政治，而且所有政策制定者支持同一措施。
政党政治可能影响环境政策，但这不等于每位政治人物都支持同一措施。
环境政治决定所有政客必须执行同一项政策。
politics、policy 和 politician 在这里都可以统一译为“政策”。

exp.trans: 报告说，政党政治可能影响环境政策，但它并没有声称每位政治人物都支持同一措施。
exp.structure: party politics是主语，can influence是谓语，environmental policy是宾语；but连接限制，it指report，that从句是否定其没有作出的强结论。
exp.other: party politics 政党政治；environmental 环境的；measure 措施；claim 声称。
exp.meaning: 同一词根不等于同一词义。politics是政治，policy是政策，politician是政治人物；读长文时要让这些词在全文里形成一致的语义链。
exp.rest: A混淆politics/policy并扩大为所有人支持；C加入“必须执行”的强制关系；D正是需要避免的词族误认。

questions.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
questions.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

questions.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
questions.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

questions.target: set A apart from B / be closely tied
questions.q: The company keeps approval and sales decisions formally separate precisely because the two teams are closely tied through shared bonuses. Which reading is best?
o: 两个团队彼此没有关系，所以没有必要区分决策。
两个团队现实利益联系紧密，因此制度上反而需要刻意把两类决策分开。
shared bonuses证明销售团队已经接管审批团队。
closely tied表示两个团队被绳子绑在一起。

exp.trans: 公司之所以在制度上把审批与销售决策分开，恰恰是因为两个团队通过共同奖金存在紧密利益联系。
exp.structure: The company是主语，keeps A and B separate是谓语结构；precisely because引出原因，the two teams是主语，are closely tied是系表结构。
exp.other: approval 审批；formally 正式地/制度上；bonus 奖金；shared 共同的。
exp.meaning: set/keep A apart/separate from B表示区分；be closely tied表示紧密相关。because并不要求“原因”和“措施”表面同方向：正因为现实容易纠缠，制度上才需要分开。
exp.rest: A与closely tied相反；C把联系紧密夸大成组织接管；D把比喻性关系搭配按字面绳子理解。

title-specificity.target: 标题具体性 / 抓反复强调的特殊现象
title-specificity.q: 短文：越来越多研究团队会在同行评审完成前先发布预印本。作者反复讨论这样做的速度优势、误读风险，以及“先公开、后评审”正在改变学术传播节奏。哪个标题最贴切？
o: Science Is Changing
The Only Future for Researchers
Publishing Before Peer Review
Why Research Is Difficult

exp.trans: 短文核心是：越来越多团队在同行评审完成之前先公开预印本，并讨论这种“先公开、后评审”的新节奏。
exp.structure: 题干给了三类信息：现象（先发预印本）、利弊（速度/误读风险）、趋势（改变传播节奏）。标题应抓住反复出现的特殊条件，而不是只抓大类话题science/research。
exp.other: preprint 预印本；peer review 同行评审；misreading 误读；academic communication 学术传播。
exp.meaning: 好标题通常覆盖全文最特殊、反复出现的现象。Publishing Before Peer Review直接命中“评审前发布”。
exp.rest: Science Is Changing过于宽泛；The Only Future含Only，原文只说越来越多，不是唯一道路；Why Research Is Difficult把主题偷换成研究困难。

title-specificity.target: 主旨标题 / 特殊限定条件
title-specificity.q: 短文：一些游客现在会在签证获批前就购买可退改机票。文章重点讨论这种“先订票、后等签证”的风险和好处。哪个标题最好？
o: Travel in the Modern World
Booking Before Approval
The Only Smart Way to Travel
Why Visas Should Disappear

exp.trans: 短文关注的是一种具体行为：在签证批准之前先订可退改机票，并讨论其风险与好处。
exp.structure: 主旨由反复出现的时间关系“before approval”限定。标题需要既覆盖行为，又保留这个特殊条件。
exp.other: visa approval 签证获批；refundable 可退款的；risk 风险；benefit 好处。
exp.meaning: Booking Before Approval准确概括特殊现象；不是只说“旅游”，也不夸大成唯一正确方式。
exp.rest: Travel in the Modern World范围太大；The Only Smart Way含绝对化Only，原文只说“一些游客”；Why Visas Should Disappear引入原文没有的政策主张。

title-specificity.target: 标题具体性 / 核心取舍
title-specificity.q: 短文讨论两条普通车道改成公交专用道后的试验：公交通行更快，附近商铺的货车却因绕行而送货更慢。文章比较这两类影响。哪个标题最贴切？
o: Funding the City’s New Bus Fleet
How Smaller Buses Save Road Space
Faster Bus Trips, Harder Local Deliveries
More Frequent Services for Busy Routes

exp.trans: 把两条普通车道改成公交专用道后，公交更快，附近商铺送货更慢。Faster Bus Trips, Harder Local Deliveries是“公交更快，附近送货更难”，概括本文的具体取舍。
exp.structure: 文章用试验结果对照受益者与受影响者。标题两部分平行呈现同一措施的两种影响，不能把新规则误写成采购车辆或增加班次。
exp.other: bus fleet 公交车队；road space 道路空间；delivery 送货；frequent service 密集班次。
exp.meaning: 具体性来自措施和后果的关系，不只是找Before或排除Only。四个标题都像交通文章标题，需核对究竟是哪一种改变。
exp.rest: Funding...转成车队资金问题；Smaller Buses换成车辆大小这一原因；More Frequent Services改成增加班次。三者都是可能的交通议题，但不是给定试验的机制。

expectation-contrast.skill: 转折逻辑不是正负翻转
expectation-contrast.q: The new timetable was designed to reduce delays. Yet average waiting time increased in its first month. Which relation is expressed?
o: 第二句说明第一句的目标已经实现。
第二句与第一句毫无逻辑关系，只是补充新数据。
实际结果违背了设计目标所产生的预期。
yet表示因为等待时间增加，所以才设计新时刻表。

exp.trans: 新的时刻表原本是为了减少延误而设计的，然而第一个月的平均等待时间反而增加了。这里是目标与实际结果之间的逆预期。
exp.structure: The new timetable是主语，was designed是被动谓语，to reduce delays说明目的；第二句average waiting time + increased。
exp.other: timetable 时刻表；delay 延误；average 平均的；waiting time 等待时间。
exp.meaning: 看到yet先问“前一句让我预期什么，后一句如何违背它”。不必先判断哪句是褒义、哪句是贬义。
exp.rest: A与increased矛盾；B忽略目标—结果关系；D把时间与因果方向倒置。

social-message-inference.target: 社会评价 / 信息影响
social-message-inference.q: A workplace culture repeatedly celebrates employees who stay late, and workers who leave on time are often reminded that “real commitment means sacrifice.” What is most safely suggested?
o: Workers who leave on time are formally punished every day.
The culture may make some workers question whether they are committed enough.
Employees who stay late are always more productive.
Managers ignore workers who leave on time.

exp.trans: 一种职场文化反复赞美加班员工，而准时下班的人经常被提醒“真正的投入意味着牺牲”。最稳妥的推断是：这种文化可能让一些人怀疑自己是否足够投入。
exp.structure: 主句1：A workplace culture + celebrates + employees。who stay late修饰employees。主句2：workers who leave on time + are reminded + that从句。that从句给出被灌输的信息。题目要从这种持续信息推断心理影响，而不是擅自添加处罚事实。
exp.other: workplace culture 职场文化；commitment 投入/忠诚；sacrifice 牺牲；question whether 怀疑是否。
exp.meaning: 持续传递带否定意味的价值标准可以构成广义批评，不必出现直接人身侮辱。本题的具体线索支持自我评价可能受到影响，但不支持正式惩罚或跨群体满意度比较。
exp.rest: formally punished every day加入原文没有的正式处罚；always more productive把价值宣传偷换成生产率事实；ignore与“are often reminded”相反。

social-message-inference.target: 社会评价 / 信息影响
social-message-inference.q: At a school, the wall of honour lists only perfect test scores. A pupil who has improved greatly still asks, “Does my progress count if I never appear on that wall?” Which inference is best supported?
o: The pupil has been personally insulted by every teacher.
The display may lead the pupil to doubt the value of improvement without perfection.
The school has failed to display any test scores.
Every pupil with a perfect score has made greater progress.

exp.trans: 一所学校的荣誉墙只列满分成绩。一名进步很大的学生仍问：“如果我从未登上那面墙，我的进步还算数吗？”最稳妥的推断是：这种展示可能让他怀疑没有满分的进步是否有价值。
exp.structure: 第一句：the wall of honour + lists + only perfect test scores。第二句：A pupil + asks + 引语；who has improved greatly修饰pupil。引语里if从句给出没有上榜这一条件。学生的问题体现了对进步价值的怀疑。
exp.other: wall of honour 荣誉墙；perfect score 满分；progress 进步；count 有价值/算数。
exp.meaning: 持续传递带否定意味的价值标准可以构成广义批评，不必出现直接人身侮辱。本题的具体线索支持自我评价可能受到影响，但不支持正式惩罚或跨群体满意度比较。
exp.rest: personally insulted无直接侮辱证据，every teacher还扩大范围；failed to display any scores与列出满分矛盾；greater progress把最终成绩偷换成进步幅度。

social-message-inference.target: 反复信息 / 评价与比较
social-message-inference.q: The town newsletter repeatedly portrays residents who do not volunteer as “taking from the town without giving back.” Non-volunteers hear this judgment week after week. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: Every resident wants the newsletter to close.
Non-volunteers are repeatedly exposed to disapproving social judgments.
The newsletter never mentions non-volunteers.
Non-volunteers are generally less happy than volunteers.

exp.trans: 镇上的简报反复把不做志愿服务的居民描述成“只索取而不回馈”。他们周复一周听到这种评价。可以确认：他们持续接收到带否定意味的社会评价。
exp.structure: The town newsletter + portrays + residents + as引语。who do not volunteer修饰residents；第二句Non-volunteers + hear + this judgment，this judgment回指前文负面描述，week after week强调反复。
exp.other: newsletter 简报；volunteer 做志愿服务；give back 回馈；disapproving 不赞同的；judgment 评价。
exp.meaning: 带否定意味的评价即使没有直接辱骂，也可以构成criticism。题文直接支持这种评价持续存在，不提供两个群体幸福水平的比较。
exp.rest: Every resident扩大到全部居民并猜测态度；never mentions与反复描述无志愿服务者矛盾；generally less happy把受评价的处境扩大成群体幸福比较，没有比较数据或明确陈述。

familiar-word-polysemy.target: dismiss A as B / address concerns
familiar-word-polysemy.skill: 熟词生义 + 固定搭配
familiar-word-polysemy.q: Officials first dismissed the complaint as trivial, but later had to address the evidence it contained. Which paraphrase is best?
o: 他们先解雇了投诉人，后来查找证据的地址。
他们起初把投诉斥为无足轻重，后来不得不处理其中的证据。
他们先证明投诉正确，后来决定忽视证据。
他们先将投诉寄出，后来改变了通信地址。

exp.trans: 官员们起初把这项投诉斥为无足轻重，但后来不得不处理其中包含的证据。
exp.structure: Officials是主语；dismissed是第一个谓语，the complaint是宾语，as trivial是宾补；but后had to address是第二个谓语结构，the evidence是宾语。
exp.other: complaint 投诉；trivial 微不足道的；evidence 证据；contain 包含。
exp.meaning: dismiss可表示“解雇”，但dismiss A as B是“把A斥为/视为B而不予重视”；address作动词可表示“处理、应对问题/担忧/证据”，不只表示地址。
exp.rest: A把两个熟词都套成名词/常见义；C反转了dismiss与address的语义；D虚构邮寄和地址变化。

politics-policy.skill: 词族辨析 + 全文语义链
politics-policy.q: The city changed its housing ___ after several local ___ argued that the old rules favored large developers. Which pair fits both blanks?
o: politics / policies
policy / politicians
politician / politics
policies / political

exp.trans: 在几位当地政治人物认为旧规定偏袒大型开发商之后，这座城市修改了住房政策。两个空分别需要“政策”和“政治人物”。
exp.structure: The city是主语，changed是谓语，its housing ___是宾语；after从句中several local ___是主语，argued是谓语，that从句说明其主张。
exp.other: housing 住房；favor 偏袒/有利于；developer 开发商；local 当地的。
exp.meaning: policy=政策；politician=政治人物/政客；politics=政治活动/政治；political=政治的。不要因为它们都以polit-开头就统一译成“政策”。
exp.rest: politics不能作“住房政策”这一可数具体制度；policies不能指“几位当地政治人物”；politician放第一空词性和语义都不合；political是形容词，不能单独作several local后的中心名词。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: The healthier seedlings caused the gardeners to provide shade.
Shade provided by the gardeners reduced the seedlings' exposure to heat.
The seedlings protected the gardeners from the heat.
The heat was reduced because the seedlings dried out.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: healthier seedlings caused...把结果当成原先行动的原因；seedlings protected gardeners交换了保护者与被保护者；heat was reduced because...反转因果，还把减少高温暴露偷换成降低环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension made firms miss the earlier deadline.
The later participation figures caused the council to extend the round.
The missed deadline prompted an extension; its effect on later participation is still unknown.
The earlier deadline was introduced in response to the extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: The extension made...让下一轮的措施反过来造成先前错过期限；later participation figures不存在已测量数据，不能成为依据；earlier deadline ... in response to the extension把较早规则与后来的回应倒置。

relation-collocation.skill: 关系搭配 + 反直觉因果
relation-collocation.q: The audit office is structurally independent from the ministry because its work is closely tied to decisions the ministry would otherwise judge itself. What is the logic?
o: 工作联系越紧密，两个机构在制度上越不需要独立。
由于审计事项与被审部门的决定紧密相关，制度上保持独立可减少自己审自己的问题。
closely tied说明审计办公室必须归部长直接管理。
because在这里表示转折，所以前后没有因果。

exp.trans: 审计办公室在组织上独立于该部门，因为它的工作与该部门原本可能自行评判的决定紧密相关。正因为利益和事项联系密切，制度上才需要独立。
exp.structure: The audit office是主语，is structurally independent是系表；because从句中its work是主语，is closely tied to是谓语结构，decisions是介词宾语。
exp.other: audit 审计；structurally 组织结构上；ministry 部门/部；otherwise 否则。
exp.meaning: closely tied to=与……紧密相关；independent from=独立于。文章常出现“现实联系紧密→制度上刻意分离”的治理逻辑，不能因为表面反向就否定because。
exp.rest: A把治理逻辑反了；C把“相关”偷换成组织隶属；D错误解释because。
